tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang chog bzhugs// ༄༅// rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rjes 'gro ba sdug bsngal las// sgrol mdzad sgrol ma la btud de// de yi dbang bskur cho ga'i rim// gzhan gyis bskul phyir bdag gis bshad// de la dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ snying rjes sems can rjes su 'dzin par 'dod pas/ bsnyen pa sngon du song zhing cho ga'i las la mkhas pa'i mtshan nyid lnga dang ldan pa'i bla ma la dad pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan zhing*/ cho ga'i spyod yul du gyur pa'i yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa'i slob mas/ bla mar gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung nas// snying po byang chub ma thob bar// bla ma dam par gsol 'debs kyis// bdag gi bla ma mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pa dang*/ bla mas/ ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung dang*// mya ngan ma 'das bzla ba'i phyir// bla mar zhu ba khyod spro 'am// zhes dri'o// slob mas kyang*/ ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung dang*// mya ngan ma 'das bzla ba'i phyir// bla mar zhu ba bdag spro'o// zhes lan gdab bo// de nas dkon mchog gi spyan sngar bla ma'i tshig gi rjes su bzlas te/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa lan gsum byas nas/ bla ma dang slob ma gnyis kas slob ma mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las bgegs mthar byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/

sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bskyed nas/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis lung byin la zlor gzhug go /slob ma rjes su gzung ba'o// de nas slob mas yo byad sbyar nas bsnyen pa la gnas par gsol ba btab ste/ slob dpon gyis bum pa la brten pa ni bum pa sta gon gyi skabs ltar ram ma brten pa sgrub thabs ltar gtso mo la 'bum phrag brgyad cu/ 'khor rnams la khri phrag brgyad cu'i bar du bzlas pa bya'o// bsnyen pa'o// de nas sa'i cho ga la phyogs dang*/ dbyibs dang*/ kha dog dang*/ mtshan ma rnams yid du 'ong zhing 'tshe ba med la/ yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ting nge 'dzin ngang gis 'phel ba'i sa phyogs dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su rigs nas/ sa de'i bdag po khyim bdag la sogs pa la ci 'byor pa'i bsnyen bkur byas nas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi las rtsom par 'tshal bas gnang bar mdzod cig ces brjod nas/ des kyang gnang ba byin par bsam pa ni mngon pa las bslang ba'o// de nas sa'i phyogs der khru gang ba'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dri'i thig le byas la/ de'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ dkar gtor dang*/ dmar gtor gnyis bsham mo// de nas rang nyid sgrol ma'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas me tog gi tshom bu stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du bam̐ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas dbang po khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod la/ lag pa g.yas pa sa la bsnun pas sa'i lha mo spyan drangs la mdun bskyed la bstim/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs pa la mchod nas 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de la oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sngon du sbyar ba'i/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ la sogs pas mchod nas/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī a kā ro la sogs pa lan gsum gyis phul nas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar// de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde// pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ sa'i lha mos kyang rig pa 'dzin pa khyod ci dga' bar byos shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo// de nas dmar gtor snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas nag po'i phyogs la dga' ba'i sa'i bdag po thams cad la byin par bsam zhing*/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu kha bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ grih+ne daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis byin nas/ sa'i phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i gzhi'i bdag po dkyil 'khor chen po blta bar mi dbang ba de dag gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ dkyil 'khor gyi las ma tshar gyi bar du sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par song shig gang dag dkyil 'khor blta bar dbang ba de dag ni ma skrag par 'khod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi las bsgrub pa'i stong grogs gyis shig dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bri// khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// gal te nga yi tshig las 'da' byed na// ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*// bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za// zhes brjod nas drag po'i sngags brjod cing*// rol mo'i sgra drag tu byas la bgegs rnams bskrad par bsam mo// de nas sa'i lha mo la mchod nas/

oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol nas dam tshig pa mi dmigs par bsams la las kyi rjes bsdu'o// mi mngon pa las bslang ba ste sa bslang ba'o// de nas lto 'phye'i lto ba'i phyogs nas pus mo'am lte ba nub tsam du sa brkos nas/ sol ba dang*/ rus pa dang*/ gyo mo dang*/ spu la sogs pa'i zug rngu rnams phyung nas dri bzang dang*/ rin po che'i phye ma dang bcas pa'i sa bzang pos bkang la/ 'thas par brdungs nas dkyil 'khor dang 'tsham pa'i sa stegs gru bzhi shar dang byang cung zad gzhol zhing shin tu 'jam pa bya'o// de ltar byar mi rung ba'i sa phyogs su lag mthil gyi hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas zug rngu thams cad sbyangs par bsam zhing sa phyogs kun du lag pas chag chag byas la/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa dang*/ oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam mo// de'i dbus su slob dpon rang nyid sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang*/ phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma bzhis rang rang gi lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas rdo rje slob dpon bskul ba'i phyir/ shar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes pa dang*/ lho nas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes pa dang*/ nub nas/ zhi ba'i chos mchog las byung ba// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong mdzad// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes pa dang*/ byang nas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag pa'i dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur// dkyil 'khor snying po bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha'i sngags dang*/

rdo rje 'degs pa'i phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyis dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg nas/ mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma dang*/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla bar dmigs la/ g.yas nas g.yon du blta bas bgegs thams cad tshar gcad cing*/ g.yon nas g.yas su blta bas rjes su bzung la/ rkang mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa re bsams nas rdo rje'i gom pas byang shar du song la/ hūm̐ lus ngag sems la gnas pa'i bgegs// 'dir nyon nga ni dpal dang ldan// bka' yi 'khor lo rab bskor ba// nga yi bka' yi dam tshig las// su 'das brlag 'gyur the tshom med// mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs// gdon gyi rigs su gtogs pa rnams// 'di ru ma gnas gzhan du dengs// zhes pa dang*/ sum+bha la sogs pa'i drag po'i sngags brjod cing rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o// de nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyis g.yas skor du song la/ shar du g.yas brkyang*/ lhor g.yon brkyang*/ nub tu sa ga byang du zlum po'i rkang stabs rnams byas pas rkang pa'i rjes rnams sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la sa gzung ba'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug ste/ swa bhā was sa phyogs stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi snang ba las grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms nas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hās byin gyis brlab bo// sa'i cho ga'o// //de nas sta gon du gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi ba byung dang*/ dri bzang pos byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi phyi'i khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga la sogs pa gang 'byor bas bskor zhing*/ gos zung*/ nang mchod/ ku sha

so shing la sogs pa'i nye bar mkho ba rnams dang*/ gtor ma lnga bshams nas phyi ma red kyi tshe sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa 'khod la/ sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis der 'dus pa'i 'byung po rnams la bsngos nas snod ma yin pa bskrad/ snod dang ldan pa rnams la grogs gzhol/ gnas dang yo byad rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgya che bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rol mo'i sgra drag tu brdungs la/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi'i sngags brjod do// de nas las kyi slob mas rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab la/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs te/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas/ bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// de nas 'khor rnams dang yab rang la bsdu/ rang nyid rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal gyis mchod rdzas rnams bigh+nan+ta kṛ ta kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ las grub pa'i lha rdzas kyi mchod pa rnams su bskyed la so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo// de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa sa bslang ba'i skabs bzhin du bya'o// de nas ba byung dang*/ dri bzang sbyar ba'i chu dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su blugs pa dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du byug cing*/ oṃ me di nī badz+rī bha ba hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsam/ yang khor yug kun du byug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas srung ba'i 'khor lo rdzogs par bskyed/ dbus su gru bzhir byug cing*/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ bi mā na gā ra kū ṭā hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas rin po che'i gzhal yas khang grub zhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par bskyed nas/ lha'i gnas su dri'i thig le me tog gi tshom bu cung zad re bkod pa dang bcas pa so so'i gdan du bskyed la/ oṃ tām̐ badz+ra tā rā na maḥs dbus su me tog tshom bu bkod pa sgrol ma dang*/

oṃ āḥ.a mo gha sid+dhi na maḥs de nyid du tshom bu gcig bsnan pa don yod grub par bskyed/ de nas shar nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas/ oṃ oṃ bai ro tsa na na maḥs rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ oṃ trām̐ rat+na saṃ bha wa na maḥs rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ oṃ hrīḥ.a mi tā bha na maḥs 'od dpag med/ oṃ hūm̐ ak+ṣo bh+ya na maḥs mi bskyod pa dang*/ yang shar lho nas rim pas/ oṃ lam̐ lo tsa ni na maḥs spyan ma dang*/ oṃ tāṃ rat+na tā ra na maḥs rin chen sgrol ma dang*/ oṃ pam̐ paṇ+ḍa ra ba si nī na maḥs gos dkar mo dang*/ oṃ mam̐ mā ma kī na maḥs mā ma kī dang*/ yang phyi'i shar lho nas rim pas/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dhū pe na maḥs bdug spos ma dang*/ oṃ trām̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe na maḥs me tog ma dang*/ oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra dī pe na maḥs mar me ma dang*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe na maḥs dri ma dang*/ shar nas rim pas/ oṃ dzaḥbadz+ra aṃ gu sha na maḥs lcags kyu ma dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra pā sh+ya na maḥs zhags pa ma dang*/ oṃ baṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa na maḥs lcags sgrog ma dang*/ oṃ hoḥbadz+ra ghan+ḍe na maḥs dril bu ma rnams bskyed la/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas nas/ phyi'i mchod pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin mchod par bsam zhing*/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tā rā bha ga wa ti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā la sogs pa rol mo'i bar gyis mchod nas/ gos zung du sbyar ba bzung la/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol// mi phyed mos pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ tā rā bha ga wa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra was+t+rā ya aḥs na bza' 'bul lo// phyi'i mchod pa'o// //de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/

mtheb srin gyi 'thor mas rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phul nas/ lce la myangs pas lus kyi lha mchod la/ chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la so so'i sngags kyis mchod pa ni/ nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa'o// de nas bris pa la sogs pa'i 'dod yon lnga thogs pa'am/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ yid kyis sprul pa'i 'dod yon rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tā rā bha ga wa ti sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi ti āḥhūm̐ gis gzugs dang*/ shab+da kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis sgra dang*/ gan+dha kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dri dang*/ ra sa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis ro dang*/ spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis reg byas mchod pa ste/ mchod pa'o// de nas phyag 'tshal ba nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas bstod nas/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin gtor ma dang po bcom ldan 'das ma dang*/ gnyis pa chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa phyogs skyong dang*/ bzhi pa rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ lnga pa mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor mas bsngos nas mkhyen par gsol ba'i phyir/ pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs nas spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i// dpa' bo rnal 'byor dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor bri// 'dir ni sangs rgyas kun gshegs te// dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhal nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod ci dga' bar byos shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo// lha sta gon no// de nas bum pa lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ dbang gi bum pa lnga las thams cad pa ste drug gam/

bsdu na gnyis te/ gang grub pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang zhing mgul chings dang*/ kha rgyan dang bcas pa rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'i steng du dung chos bcud kyis gang ba'i steng du rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa bshams la/ bigh+nān+ta kṛ ta kyis bsang*/ swa bha was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ji ltar bshams pa ltar bskyed pa'i nang du so so'i gdan gyi steng du ā li phrag gnyis las zla ba/ kā li phrag gnyis las nyi ma/ bar du sa bon las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de dag gcig tu 'dres pa las bum pa re rer lha re re 'am/ gtso mo la 'khor gzhan gyis bskor ba dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i bum par rigs bzhi dang*/ las thams cad par bgegs mthar byed dam/ dbang gi bum par dkyil 'khor gyi lha bcu bdun dang*/ las thams cad par bgegs mthar byed bskyed de/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams ni sgrub thabs dang mthun la/ bgegs mthar byed ni slob ma yongs gzung gi skabs ltar ro// de rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas pa'i rjes la mchod cing bstod nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas lha rnams kyi rgyud bskul bas so so'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ sgrub thabs dang*/ slob ma yongs su gzung ba'i skabs ltar sngags rnams ji ltar nus pa bzla'o// slar yang mchod cing bstod la/ dung chos kyi chu bum pa rnams su blugs pas lha rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi chur blta'o// bum pa sta gon no// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad byin gyis brlabs pas phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod nas/ lhag gtor gyi bar byas la/ 'das pa'i gtor ma bsrung ba'i phyir bzhag cing*/ gzhan rnams gtang ngo*// de nas gsang ba'i rdzas rnams bsgrigs nas slob ma rnams khrus byas te/

bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal nas 'khod pa la/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bdag nyid brgal zhing gzhan yang bsgral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ dbang bskur ba zhu'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa bskyed cing*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcug la/ me tog dang*/ bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te/ dga' chen khyod la bdag dga' 'o// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i// mgon po chen po bdag la stsol// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems ni bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs su gzhug go /de nas rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od kyis slob ma rnams rang gi zhal gyi sgor bcug snying ga'i tām̐ gis sdig pa sbyangs nas mkhar bab pa sgrol mar bskyed la/ ye shes pa bstim zhing*/ dbang bskur nas don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa spros nas rang gi gnas su 'khod pa la/ bla mas gsol ba btab pa'i lan gdab pa'i phyir/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// gsang sngags tshul bzhin spyod pa ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// rdo rje gsang sngags 'di bsgoms pas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// bdud sde shin du mi bzad pa// dpung dang bcas pa rab bcom nas// 'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs pa yis// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod pas gsang sngags kyi che ba brjod cing*/

des bsgrub par khas blang ngo*// de nas slob ma la rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i phyir/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum du brjod du gzhug go /de nas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas pa'i srin lag gis las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chu blangs te/ slob ma'i dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ yi ge de dag tu gyur la/ mas yar reg cing 'bru gsum brjod pas/ rdo rje dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ 'khor lor gyur par bsam mo// yang yas mar rim pa bzhin reg cing 'bru gsum brjod pas/ phyag mtshan de dag la/ yig 'bru de dag gis mtshan par bsam pa la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs nas/ byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// de dag la me tog la sogs pa mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ deng nas bzung nas bu khyod kyis// 'khor ba'i nyes pas mi gos par// mchod pa kun dang ldan par ni// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod do// de nas tshom bu gcig pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du sor brgyad dam bcu gnyis kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i so shing gser las grub par bsams la/ oṃ dzi hwa badz+ra saṃ war+dha ni zhes pa'i sngags kyis byin pa/ slob ma'i sos bldad de sdig pa thams cad skyugs par bsams la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dor ba'i rtse mo shar du phyogs pas zhi ba dang*/

byang du rgyas pa dang*/ nub tu dbang dang*/ lhor drag po dang*/ steng du mkha' la spyod pa dang*/ 'og tu rin po che'i gter dang*/ mtshams rnams su phyogs pas dngos grub phra mo rnams 'grub par lung bstan no// de nas oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha s+sarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsa saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpa a pa na ya hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sngags kyis las thams cad pa'i chu blud pas sdig pa dang*/ dri ma thams cad sbyang ngo*// de nas skud pa dmar po'am ser po lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum bltab tu bkal zhing rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum byas pa hūm̐ las rdo rje'i srad bur byin gyis brlabs pa la ye shes kyi skud pa spyan drangs pa bstim la/ yi ge bcu pas bsngags pa slob ma skyes pa rnams kyi dpung pa g.yon pa dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas par yi ge brgya pa brjod cing bcings pas bsrungs nas/ lag pa g.yas par ku sha'i chun po chung ba dhīḥdang*/ g.yon par che ba haḥzhes brjod nas byin la/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam du ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang na mi 'byung srid// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// 'gro don mnyam med byed par 'gyur// gzhan yang theg pa chen po yi// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'bras thob par// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur// des na bu yis brtson par gyis// zhes brjod cing don bshad de/ spro ba brtan por bya'o// de nas ku sha chung ba sngas dang*/ che ba stan du bcug la/ mgo byang ngam shar du bstan nas gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu bcug ste/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces zlos bzhin pas lha dang bla ma yid la byed cing nyol la/

rmi lam du mthong ba rnams nang par nga la smros shig ces bsgos nas so so'i gnas su gtong ngo*// nang par rmi lam bshad pa'i tshe mi dge ba mthong na chos thams cad stong pa nyid yid la byed pa dang*/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi bsgom pa dang*/ bzlas pas zhi bar bya'o// dge bar mthong na spro ba bskyed do// de nas bla mas me tog tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod nas/ oṃ badz+ro tiṣ+ṭha'i sngags dang*/ phyag rgyas nam mkha' la bteg la/ mchod cing bstod nas/ slob ma'i bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bzhugs su gsol lo// me tog tshom bu la sogs pa las kyi rjes rnams bsdus nas/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol la/ gtor ma'ang gtang ngo*// nam mkha' la bteg pa'i lha mchod pa'i phyir/ mchod pa gsar pa bshams la/ rang nyid nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas nyal bar bya'o// sta gon gyi cho ga'o// //de nas nang par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs la/ dag pa gsum dran par byas nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha s+sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi ba byung dang*/ dri bzang gis legs par byugs la/ cha chen bcu drug sgo rkyang pa/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang*/ lha snam ste/ 'phar ma gnyis dang ldan pa'i rkyang pa dang*/ bskor ba'i las kyi thig gdab par bya ste/ mthong ba brgyud pa las shes par bya'o// de'i steng du drang bar bde zhing mdog phun sum tshogs pa'i rdul tshon bdud rtsi'i ri lus sbags pa/ ljang gu la aḥbris pa dbus dang*/ dkar po la oṃ bris pa shar dang*/ ser po la trāṃ bris pa lho dang*/ dmar po la hrīḥbris pa nub dang*/ sngon po la hūm̐ bris pa byang du bkod pa'i steng du srin bal la sogs pa las byas pa'i srad bu sbom phra dang*/ ring thung dang*/ 'jur mdud med pa lnga sgril du bkal ba dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur gyi tshad dang mnyam pa rnams tshon sna lngas bsgyur la gzhag go

/de'i mdun du mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma bshams pa la phyogs pas slob dpon shar du 'dug la/ sgrol ma'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms te/ thig tshon rnams bigh+nān+ta kṛ ta kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las sa bon so so las rigs lnga yum lnga dang bcas pa bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan pa la phyi nang gis mchod/ don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas// la sogs pas bstod/ de dag snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū traṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi shar du bltas te langs la/ thig skud rnams blangs te g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis thig sna 'dzin la bgegs mthar byed kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa la rim pas gtad de/ gnyis char gyis dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod do// de nas/ phan tshun rjes su rtogs pa ste// chos kun phan tshun rjes su 'gro// chos rnams thams cad shin tu yang*// kun tu 'gro bar chos kun brjod// ces brjod cing lnga ka lhan cig tu bsgril nas rdo rje la dkris te/ nang mchod kyis gtor ro// de nas slob dpon shar bltas slob ma nub// tshangs thig dang po gdab par bya// slob dpon lhor 'dug slob ma byang*// gnyis pa yang ni gdab par bya// me yi phyogs su gnas pa yis// byang bltas shar gyi thig gdab bya// rlung gnas lhor bltas nub thig gdab// de nyid las ni byang ngos gdab// mer gnas lho phyogs thig bya zhing*// de nas rlung gi phyogs su bya// bden bral gnas pas dbang ldan par// rim pas ji bzhin gdab par bya// de'i tshe/ nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams// 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags pas// khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar// thig skud sgra yis bskul bar bgyi// zhes pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū traṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/

zhes brjod cing*/ thig chen brgyad/ 'og dang steng cha gnyis su btab pas gzhal yas khang gi rnam par grub par bltas nas/ shar nub tu gnas pas rdo rje la thig skud dkris pa la bdud rtsi gtor nas/ oṃ badz+ra be ge kra ma ho/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas ye shes kyi thig rnams nam mkha' la bteg nas rdo rje dril bu dkur 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su song la/ 'gying ba dang bcas pas phyogs bzhir mig shin tu gdangs bas blta zhing*/ hi zhes brjod pas sgo bzhi bye bar bsam mo// de nas slob dpon dbus nas shar du bltas te/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tsi tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐ gis rdul tshon rnams bsngags nas g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa'i nang nas rim pa bzhin ljang gu/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ sngon po rnams sgo logs kyi tshad dang mnyam pa/ sbom phra dang*/ 'dres pa dang*/ bar chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa dang bral pa g.yas skor du bri zhing*/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// sems can khams ni rab grol byed// bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma yi// dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bya// zhes pa dang*/ gong gi sngags brjod cing bris la/ rigs lnga'i ngo bor bltas nas mchod de/ ka pā las kha bcad pa'i steng du thig skud kyis dkris pa'i rdo rje bzhag la/ hūm̐ gi sngags kyis dbus kyi phur bu phyung ba'i bu gar sngar gyi rim pas rdul tshon rnams kyis dgang ngo*// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba ser po/ 'dab ma mdzes tshon/ mu khyud dmar po la ral gri'i phreng ba bkod pa/ lha snam dmar po/ sgo bzhi shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang sngon po/ grwa bzhir bum pa gnyis gnyis te bum pa brgyad/ rta babs dang*/ 'dod yon dang*/ pha gu dang*/ drwa ba drwa phyed dang*/ mda' yab la sogs pa rnams dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun par byas pa la mtshan ma dgod pa ni/

dbus su ut+pa la ljang gu la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje shar dang*/ shar lhor 'khor lo/ lho dang*/ lho nub tu rin po che/ nub dang*/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang dang*/ byang shar du rdo rje dang*/ lha snam gyi shar lhor spos khang*/ lho nub tu me tog nub byang du mar me/ byang shar du dri'i dung chos/ shar sgor lcags kyu/ lho sgor zhags pa/ nub sgor lcags sgrog byang sgor dril bu rnams so so'i kha dog dang mthun par dgod do// rta babs kyi gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje/ gzhal yas khang gi gzhi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ljang gu/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma mdzes tshon/ de'i phyi rol du mu khyud la phyogs skyong ba rnams dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i mtshan ma rnams so so'i thad sor bkod pa'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ me'i khor yug bri'o// de'i phyi rol du mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma rnams kyis bskor zhing*/ bla re dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan la sogs pas dkyil 'khor gyi gnas nye bar brgyan zhing mdzes par bya'o// de nas phyi dro'i dus kyi tshe/ slob dpon sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa 'khod de/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma btang ba nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'i bar sta gon ltar bya'o// de nas las thams cad pa'i chu'am nang mchod kyis dkyil 'khor la gtor zhing*/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs ltar bskyed cing*/ khor yug la phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi bskyed la bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor dang yang gnyis su med par bsres nas/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod nas bstim mo// slar yang ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ dbang bskur nas rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ so so'i sngags lan bdun bdun brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas bdag nyid gtso mo'i thugs ka nas sgrol ma nyid dam/

don yod grub pa'i nga rgyal gyis bye nas shar du gnas pas dkyil 'khor la mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma'i bar sta gon gyi skabs ltar byas nas/ dkyil 'khor blta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du gtor ma bshams la rdo rje gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i sngags dang*/ phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ phyi rol pa'i 'byung po rnams la byin par bsam zhing*/ oṃ de wa/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ gan+dhar+bha/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya/ sarba bhū te bh+yo na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grih+ne daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ dkyil 'khor chen po blta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par dengs shig ces brjod la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas gtor ma gtang ngo*// //de nas dkyil 'khor gyi drung shar phyogs su 'dug nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sgo bzhi phye bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra dha rod+gha ṭa ya badz+ra sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes brjod nas/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rnams gtso mos mdzad cing*/ dbang rdzas gtod pa la sogs pa'i las rnams de'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i bgegs mthar byed kyis mdzad par bsam zhing*/ slob ma la ji tsam dbang bskur ba rnams rang gis blang bar bya'o// bdag nyid 'jug pa'o// //de nas slob ma thogs pa med par 'jug par bya ba'i phyir rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun du byung*// de bzhin nyid las nges par byung*// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod do// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad kyis phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod pa lhag gtor gyi bar byas nas/

gsang ba'i rdzas rnams bsgrib pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bcad nas slob ma rnams khrus byas te phyag 'tshal nas rim pas 'khod pas dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ sta gon gyi skabs ltar/ dga' chen khyod la bdag dga' 'o// zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsol ba lan gsum btab la/ oṃ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcing zhing*/ me tog gi phreng ba gtad la/ bigh+nān ta kṛ ta kyi sngags dang las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus bsangs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi 'thung du bcug pas byin gyis brlabs la/ skad cig gis bgegs mthar byed du bskyed do// de'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa bsgoms la/ bla mas rdo rje snying gar bzhag cing*/ gnyis kas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes brjod la/ slob dpon gyis/ su ra ti sa ma ya ho/ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// hūm̐ zhes pas gsang bar gdams nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo ma bzhi'i thugs ka nas rang dang 'dra ba'i pho nya spros pas slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod nas las kyi rdo rjes slob ma khrid nas bla ma dang*/ dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor ba'am/ bskor bar mos la/ ha ha he he/ zhes brjod cing*/ yol ba'i nang du gzhug go /de nas slob ma rnams kyis dpral bar thal mo sbyar nas/ na maste hūm̐ gis dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i sku dang*/

mgrin par thal mo sbyar nas na mo mi hūm̐ gi gsung dang*/ snying gar thal mo sbyar nas na mo nā ma hūm̐ gis thugs la phyag 'tshal du gzhug go /de nas dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// la sogs pas rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa lan gsum byed du bcug nas smon pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi sems brtan pa'i gsang sngags kyi rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i yan lag thams cad gzung ba'i bsam pas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por bdag gis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas bdag gis gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog rnal 'byor gyi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re zhing ni dus drug du// zang zing mi 'jigs dam chos dang*// byams pa rin chen rigs mchog gi /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa gzung ngo*// de nas rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di// ma mthong snod dang mi ldan pa// su la'ang ston par ma byed cig /ces yang dag par gdams nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi glud la/ 'di ni rdo rje dam tshig yin// srungs shig ma bsrungs sreg par byed// bsrungs na dngos grub ster byed pa'i// bdud rtsi 'di ni myang bar gyis// oṃ pañca a mri ta u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥzhes brjod nas mna' chu blud do// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo// de nas slob ma la chos thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma ltar shes pas rang gi lus dang*/ longs spyod la ma chags pa'i blo bskyed la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas yi ge a dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros nas slob ma'i lus la thim pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs nas mya ngan med pa'i sgrol mar gyur pa ni sku mdog dmar mo sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar zhing*/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas ral gri dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin pa bskyed pa'i spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad sgrol ma'i skur gyur pa sna tshogs rdo rje la zhugs shing slob ma'i lus la thim par dpon slob gnyis char gyis bsgoms la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tsit+ta maṇ+ḍa la badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod cing gu gul gyis bdug rol mo'i sgra drag tu byas pas ye shes phab nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya'o// yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun dngos rje btsun ma// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// rtag tu yi dam lha yin gyis// tshul 'di smra bar ma byed cig

/gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes pas ye shes zhugs kyi dbang ma thob pa la mi smra bar gdams nas slar rdo rje bzhag la/ nga ni 'phags ma sgrol ma ste// nga yis bsgo ba'i las gyis la// ma mos brnyas par ma byed cig /gal te khyod kyis brnyas na ni// dam tshig 'di yis sreg par byed// tsha ba chen po'i gnas su sreg /ces bla ma'i bka' nyan par bsgo'o// de nas bla mas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// bcom ldan rol ma'i grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*// bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du gyur// 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ slob ma rnams kyis me tog gi phreng ba thogs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo shar nas gdong g.yogs dang bcas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la bltas pas dkar por mthong na zhi ba/ ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang*/ sngon po drag po ljang gu dang*/ khra bo phrin las sna tshogs 'grub par lung bstan nas/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod pas me tog phul ba gang la phog pa de khyod kyi lhag pa'i lha yin no// zhes brjod nas/ blangs pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ pra tī grih+na swa mi maṃ satwa ma hā ba la oṃ zhes brjod nas/ rang bzhin dag pa bdag med lus// dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo'i gnas// dri med rang bzhin dkyil 'khor 'di// bu khyod kyis ni blta bar gyis// oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hrīḥprāṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ dkyil 'khor bstan la/ gtso mo nas brtsams te lha so so dang*/ dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bstan no// dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o// de nas dbang blang ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul nas/

bsam gyis mi khyab dam chos snod// dbang bskur dam pa mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas/ slob ma rin po che'i khri'i steng du sgrol ma ljang gur dmigs pa'i steng na rin po che'i gdugs/ nye 'khor thams cad mchod pas yongs su gang ba la mchod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i sangs rgyas rigs lngas dbang bskur/ yum bzhis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ khro bos bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa'i lha mos mchod pa mdzad par bsam zhing*/ dngos su phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis brjod la/ me tog gtor ba ni sngon du 'gro ba shis pa'i cho ga'o// de nas slob ma dang*/ bum pa rnams kyi chu rnams rnam rgyal du bsdus pa swa bhā was mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa/ mā ma kī dang bcas par bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pa'i rgyas btab pa snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur blta/ bla ma dang dbang gi lha rnams la bdag la chu'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni dbang bskur ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin 'dir ni dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra ā dar+sha dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma rnams dag mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa la/ mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin chu'i dbang thob pas zhe sdang dag me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo mi bskyod par gyur zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas slob ma rnams dang*/ dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las ām̐ las rin po che ām̐ gis mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan/

rin chen sgrol ma dang bcas par bskyed pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rgyas btab pa snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du blta'o// de nas bla ma dang dbang gi lha rnams la bdag la dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i// cod paṇa dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ta dz+nyā na rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbu rgyan bcing*/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod pas mchod nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rin chen 'byung ldan du gyur zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas slob ma dang*/ rdo rje mi dmigs pa'i ngang las dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med gos dkar mo dang bcas par bskyed pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyi rgyas btab pa snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i rdo rjer blta/ bla ma dang*/ dbang gi lha rnams la bdag la rdo rje'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra pra t+ya be k+ṣa dz+nyā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes gsung zhing lag pa g.yas par rdo rje sbyin/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod pas mchod nas/ 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas 'dod chags dag so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo 'od dpag med du gyur zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas slob ma dang dril bu mi dmigs pa'i ngang las kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa las don yod grub pa sgrol ma dang bcas par bskyed pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/

ye shes pa bstim/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ don yod grub pa'i rgyas btab pa snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i dril bur blta/ bla ma dang dbang gi lha rnams la/ bdag la dril bu'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ kri tā nuṣ+ṭhā na badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes gsung zhing*/ lag pa g.yon par dril bu sbyin/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa la mchod pas mchod nas/ don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin dril bu'i dbang bskur bas phrag dog dag bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo don yod grub par gyur zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas slob ma mi dmigs pa'i ngang las oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad sangs rgyas spyan dang bcas par bskyed pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ bla ma dang dbang gi lha rnams la/ bdag la ming gi dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o zhes me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs kyi ming gdags/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod pas mchod nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin ming gi dbang bskur bas gti mug dag chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rnam par snang mdzad du gyur zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de ltar khyod kyis rig pa'i dbang lnga thob pas phung po lnga sangs rgyas lngar gyur pa'i phyir bdag dang snang ba thams cad sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i ngo bor shes par gyis shig ces brjod do// rig pa'i dbang lnga'o// //de nas bla mas bdug spos la sogs pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod nas/ slob ma mi dmigs pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du tām̐ las sgrol mar bskyed la me tog gi phreng ba snyim par 'dzin du bcug nas/

slob dpon sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i thugs ka'i tām̐ gi mtha' mar 'khor ba'i sngags las sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas slob ma'i snying ga'i tām̐ gi mtha' ma bskor bar gnyis kas bsgom zhing*/ yi ge bcu pa lan gsum rjes zlos su bcug pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan bdag la byin brlabs nas// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ bla mas/ rig sngags 'di la byin lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod la me tog phreng ba spyi bor gzhag go /de nas lag par rdo rje gtad nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes brjod nas dbu rgyan dang*/ dar dpyangs la sogs pa'i rgyan dang*/ stod g.yogs dmar po dang*/ smad g.yogs kha dgo sna tshogs bskon la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes brjod pas bsrungs nas/ bu khyod la rig sngags 'di rjes su gtad kyis/ khyod kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rig sngags 'di'i gzi brjid dang*/ byin gyis rlabs kyis nyams par ma byed cig ces bsgo ba ni lha dang*/ rig sngags rjes su gnang ba'o// de nas slob dpon gyis snam sbyar gyon nas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya slob ma'i spyi bor gtugs la/ bu khyod 'khor los dbang bskur gyis// sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid yin// srid gsum ma lus sgrol mdzad ma// bde bar gshegs pas lung bstan no// kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sa 'og sa steng*/ sa bla gsum du bhur+bhu wa swaḥ gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no// zhes lung bstan no// de nas/ khams gsum bdag po rgyal srid che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud kyi sde rnams bcom zin gyis// khyod ni grong khyer mchog tu zhugs// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ swa bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/

zhes brjod nas dbugs dbyung ngo*// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ mtshan ma med par 'gro ba'i don// gang dag bdag gis byed nus pa// phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che// dpa' bo chen po bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbang stegs kyi steng na gnas pa'i slob ma swa bhā was mi dmigs pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas rdo rje snyems ma sngon mo gri gug dang*/ thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bskyed pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bo rdo rje lag pa g.yas par sbyin zhing*/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ e ṣa dha ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// de nas/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes de kho na nyid brjod nas/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ lan gsum gsor te snying gar 'dzin du bcug pas thugs kyi dam tshig bskyed/ de nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// ces pas dril bu g.yon du byin nas/ aḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa// srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur// zhes de kho na nyid brjod nas/

badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ zhes brjod cing*/ dkrol du bcug pas gsung gi dam tshig bskyed/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung shing rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// zhes gnang ba byin nas/ yum la 'khyud pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/ lha'i sku phyag rgya'i dam tshig tu bskyed pa la/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung*// sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir// shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs// dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu zung*// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du// rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// 'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i// phyag rgya dam tshig ces su bsgrags// yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro// zhes phyag rgya'i dam tshig rgyas par bshad nas// bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur// mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa la dbang gi lha dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes gsung zhing me tog gi char phab nas khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal por mnga' phul bar bsam mo// rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// de nas chos 'chad pa'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa'i phyir/ 'khor lo bris pa'i khri la slob ma bzhag nas/ lag pa g.yas par dung*/ g.yon par dril bu/ lag ngar gnyis kyi steng du pusti rnams/ oṃ badz+ra dharma tsakra a bhi ṣe ka ta a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes pas byin nas/ slob ma'i snying gar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bkod pa la ye shes kyi 'khor lo bstim/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur nas 'od dpag med kyi rgyas btab la/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni// chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pa// lus can kun la bskor bar gyis// zhes brjod/

slob mas kyang dung 'bud/ dril bu dkrol/ chos kyi 'khor lo tshul bzhin du bskor bar sems bskyed pa ni chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// rnal 'byor de nyid shes pa yis// mi bya ba ni gang yang med// dpa' bo chen po nga yi bkas// 'dod yon lnga la spyad par gyis// deng nas bzung nas bu khyod kyis// lus dang srog la mi phangs par// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// 'gro ba'i don ni dpag med byos// sems can gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// rten cing 'brel ba'i chos dang ldan// khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni// sems can don ni mtshungs med byos// zhes brjod pa ni kun tu spyod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes su gnang ba'o// de ltar/ chu/ cod paṇa/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming*/ lha dang*/ sngags sbyin pa/ lung bstan pa/ dbugs dbyung ba/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang*/ chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang*/ kun tu spyod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang ste bum pa'i dbang bcu gcig go /phal cher bum pa la gnas pas/ bum pa'i dbang zhes brjod pa yin/ phyir mi ldog dang rjes su gnang*// rdo rje slob dpon dbang yin no// nyon mongs dri ma bkrus pa dang*// sa ni dang po thob par byed// ces shes par bya'o// de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod pas bla ma la mchod nas/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yi// shes rab chen pa'i snod 'gyur phyir// dbang bskur chen po mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ bla mas/ gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yi// ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med// bdud rtsi dam pa myang ba yi// dbang bskur 'di la khyod spro'am// zhes dri/ slob mas tshig snga ma rnams kyi mthar bdag spro'o zhes lan gdab/ de nas a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis slob ma'i gdong g.yogs/

dngos sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bla ma la dbul bar bsam zhing*/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// lha mo 'di ni khyad par can// yon tan mtha' dag ldan pa ste// gsang spyod thabs kyi sbyor ba las// gsang ba'i dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ de nas bla ma don yod grub pa dang*/ phyag rgya rje btsun ma sgrol mar dmigs pa'i mkha' pad+ma dang*/ gsang ba rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas gnyis ka'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum dang*/ lte bar swā dang*/ brla gnyis la hā bkod la/ rang gi lus kyi bde bas de bzhin gshegs par mchod cing slob ma la gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i phyir snyoms par 'jug snyam pa'i 'du shes kyis mnyam par sbyor ba las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs la tshangs bug nas zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu ba'i thig le sbyor mtshams nas byung ba slob ma'i lce la bzhag cing*/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// dam tshig 'di ni ngo mtshar che// khams lnga yi ni ros gang ba// bde ba chen po myang bar gyis// 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur// byang chub sems ni yid 'ong bas// de bzhin bu khyod dbang bskur ro// zhes brjod/ slob mas/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing mid pas/ lus thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis gang*/ ngag gi dri ma thams cad dag nas 'od dpag med du gyur par bltas la gdong g.yogs dbye'o// 'di ni gsang ba'i dbang yin te// sa bcu'i ye shes thob par byed// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du bla ma la maṇ+ḍal dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod nas/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yi// ye shes chen po'i snod 'gyur phyir// shes rab ye shes dbang bskur gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug pa la/

gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yi// shes rab ye shes dri ma med// bde ba dam pa myong ba yi// dbang bskur 'di la khyod spro 'am// zhes dri/ slob mas kyang*/ tshig snga ma dag gi mthar/ bdag spro'o zhes lan gdab bo// de nas slob ma'i gdong g.yogs pa don yod grub par bskyed nas yongs su sbyangs pa'i rig ma dngos su bzhag pa'am/ yid kyis mdun du dmigs pa/ sgrol mar bskyed la/ lha mo 'di ni khyad par che// bde ba mtha' yas ster byed pa// blangs nas rnam pa thams cad du// bu yis bla med mchod par gyis// zhes brjod la gtad do// de nas rig mas/ byang chub sems ni bla med pa// bu yis de ring za nus sam// rigs lnga dag las byung ba yi// phyag rgya dad pas mchod nus sam// bshang gci khu ba rak+ta sogs// 'di nyid du ni za nus sam// nga yis gsang ba'i pad+ma yis// bde ba'i myu gu bskyed pa ste// khyod kyis rtag tu mchod nus sam// zhes dris pa'i lan du/ ji skad bshad pa'i dam tshigs rnams// lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// lha mo'i pad+ma mchod par bgyi// gsang ba'i rdzas la bdag spro'o// zhes lan btab nas/ snga ma ltar mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya snyam pa'i 'dun pas snyoms par zhugs la/ ngag gi 'dren pa dang*/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis byang chub kyi sems kyi 'gyu ba bkag nas bde ba bsgoms pas dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes bskyed la de'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /de nas rig ma'i lag pa g.yon pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ nga dang rdo rje slob dpon dang*// mched dang lcam dral thams cad dang*// khams gsum sems can ma lus la// ma mos brnyas pa ma byed cig /gzhan yang dam tshig spyod pa rnams// rtag tu khyod kyis bsrung bar gyis// deng nas bzung nas bu khyod kyis// ji srid byang chub ma thob par// sems can kun gyi don rnams ni// rtag tu rmi lam bzhin du byos// zhes brjod par bsam mo// de nas gdong g.yogs phye la/

shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob bo// zhes brda sprad do// 'di ni shes rab ye shes kyi// dbang yin mi shes kun sel cing*// bde gshegs sku gsum thob byed pa// rdo rje 'chang gis yongs su gsungs// zhes shes par bya'o// de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ mchod pa phul nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyis// gtso bo bdag la bka' drin skyobs// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ slob ma'i gdong g.yogs shing*/ skyil mo krung dang*/ mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya bcas te/ sngar gyi shes rab ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bsgom du bcug la/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes brjod pas mtshon bya chos nyid de bzhin nyid du ngo sprad la mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug go /de nas gdong g.yogs phye la/ dbang bzhi pa thob bo zhes brda sprad do// //de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa byas te/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi la gtor ma phul nas/ bla ma dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams tshogs kyis mchod nas/ bla ma la yon phul nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab la/ yi ge brgya pas cho ga lhag chad kha bskangs te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam rgya chen po btab la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces lan gsum gyis bzod par gsol la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar tā re bha ga wa tī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra muḥ
